name: com.triumdesigns.ui-agent-tools
description: Lets an AI coding agent understand and safely change Unity UI in prefabs AND scenes: a structure map with data-flow wiring, validation with baseline, transactional edits through Unity's own serialization (auto-rollback), multi-resolution screenshots, and a CLI that works with the Editor open or closed. No dependency on uGUI, TextMeshPro, UI Toolkit or any XR package.
